pass_criterion.rule: block-bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound of mean weekly net excess return vs SPY > 0 AND deflated Sharpe > 0.95 at the declared trial count

watch_criterion.rule: ensemble OOS Sharpe > SPY buy-and-hold on the same segments AND one-sided 95% block-bootstrap lower bound of mean weekly net excess over SPY > 0 after costs AND deflated Sharpe > 0.5 (observed per-period Sharpe above the expected maximum at the cumulative trial count) AND ensemble max drawdown no worse than SPY's
